description: This file defines the DrupalDateTime class, which extends the DateTimePlus class to add Drupal-specific date handling, including translation caching for formatted date strings. It includes methods for constructing date objects, preparing timezones, and formatting dates with translation support.

classes.name: DrupalDateTime
classes.description: A Drupal-specific extension of DateTimePlus that adds translation caching and timezone handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a DrupalDateTime object with optional timezone and settings, including language code.

methods.name: prepareTimezone
methods.description: Overrides timezone preparation to use Drupal's user or system default timezone.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Overrides the format method to include translation of date components with caching.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares the object for serialization, excluding the translation cache.
